name: Suntik Village
title: Suntik Village
summary: An early Gharu'ndim settlement overrun by Monougas before release; the Naqib's messenger never got through (acpedia). In the kit the village sits on the south-east corner of a table mountain (z 224) whose east face drops 100 m to the plain: an ancient stone hall with a red insect relief (0x01000E11, top 234) with a corpse and barrels on its roof, a pitched-roof hall, an octagon tower, a cottage, cacti, a red-flowered tree, a well and a glowing red stone frame. Landblocks 0x8692-0x8694 (230 m east) are missing.

landmarks.name: Stone hall with insect relief (0x01000E11)
landmarks.note: Corpse and barrels on the roof.

site.name: Suntik Village
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the mesa top 57 m north-west of the village (ground + 0.5, nothing within 10 m). The gazetteer 'suntik' entry (126 m WNW, same mesa) is an alternative.

shots.standingOrder: Spiral down clockwise from 50 m over the south slope of the Suntik mesa to 22 m above its rim, closing from 75 m to 45 m on the ruined village; keep 30 m from every roof, monougas may be faded.
shots.notes: Arrival at Suntik, the Gharu'ndim village overrun by Monougas: a gentle spiral down from 50 m over the south slope of its 100 m mesa to the rim, the ruined stone hall with the insect relief, the pitched-roof hall and the octagon tower coming close; afternoon sun behind the lens. shots.standingOrder: Pull back and up south-south-east from 25 m to 75 m off the ruined hall, out over the mesa rim until the village sits alone on its 100 m cliff above the plain; keep 12 m from the stone hall, monougas may be faded.
shots.notes: Dronie over the mesa rim: from 25 m off the ruined hall the camera pulls back and up 50 m to the south-south-east, out over the 100 m cliff, until the village sits alone on its table mountain above the plain.
